## 🎙 Podcast Script — *The Aesthetic Edge* with Rachelle Harding, COO of SD Botox  

**INTRO**  
*(Bethany)*  
"Hey everyone, and welcome back to *The Aesthetic Edge*—the podcast where we pull back the curtain on what’s actually working in the aesthetics industry right now. I’m your host, Bethany Gifford, and today we are talking strategy, leadership, and sustainable growth with one of the most respected operational minds in the field.  

My guest today is **Rachelle Harding**, the powerhouse COO of **SD Botox**, one of Southern California’s fastest-growing aesthetic brands. With nearly 20 years in the industry—including an incredible 16-year tenure at Allergan—Rachelle has done it all: clinical strategy, team leadership, operational scaling… you name it.  

She first crossed paths with Dr. Alex Roher back in 2012 when he opened his very first SD Botox location. Fast forward to 2022, and she officially joined forces with him to scale the business from 5 to 7 thriving locations—with more on the way.  

Today we’re going to dive into her journey, the systems and culture that keep SD Botox running at a high level, and what she sees coming next for our industry."  

*(pause)*  
"Rachelle, welcome to the show! I’m so excited to have you here."  

---

**SECTION 1 — BACKGROUND & CAREER JOURNEY**  

*(Bethany)*  
"Let’s start at the beginning—you spent an impressive **16 years at Allergan** before moving into operations. That’s a big pivot. What inspired that transition for you?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"You actually helped with SD Botox’s account while you were at Allergan, so you’ve known Dr. Roher for years. What did that conversation look like when you both decided it was time to officially join forces?"  

---

**SECTION 2 — OPERATIONS & GROWTH STRATEGY**  

*(Bethany)*  
"When you came on board as COO in 2022, what were your **top priorities** for the business?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"You’ve since grown SD Botox from **5 to 7 locations**—and I know you have a few more on the horizon. What does *smart* expansion look like in today’s aesthetic market?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"The industry saw some challenges in 2023—economic dips, shifting consumer habits—and with an election year ahead, many practices are being cautious. How did you prepare SD Botox for these changes?"  

---

**SECTION 3 — CULTURE & LEADERSHIP**  

*(Bethany)*  
"You’ve said before that your team *organically* echoes your **core values**. That’s not something you can fake—how did you cultivate that culture?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"What are the most important **qualities** you look for when hiring team members or building leadership?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"With multiple locations, decision-making can get complicated. How do you maintain **alignment** across the organization?"  

---

**SECTION 4 — TRENDS & INDUSTRY INSIGHT**  

*(Bethany)*  
"Let’s talk trends—how do you see **AI and automation** shaping the next wave of aesthetics?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"When you think about scaling efficiently, what systems—CRM, EMR, dashboards—do you believe are absolutely essential?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"In your mind, what does the **ideal patient journey** look like—from the first click online to the moment they walk out post-treatment?"  

---

**SECTION 5 — VISION & WHAT’S AHEAD**  

*(Bethany)*  
"Looking ahead—what excites you most about **2025 and beyond** for SD Botox?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"Can you give us a sneak peek—any new services, locations, or innovations we should be watching for?"  

---

**CLOSING**  

*(Bethany)*  
"Rachelle, this has been such a great conversation. Your approach to scaling with both *strategy* and *heart* is something I know a lot of aesthetic leaders can learn from.  

For anyone listening who wants to follow SD Botox or connect with you, where’s the best place to find you online?"  

*(Bethany)*  
"And for all of you tuning in—thank you for spending this time with us. If you enjoyed this episode, don’t forget to subscribe, leave a review, and share it with someone in your network who’s passionate about building a thriving, patient-centered aesthetic business.  

Until next time, I’m Bethany Gifford, and this is *The Aesthetic Edge*."  

---
